title: feat(nscofrm): y-probe same-tick formdraw PVM: reverse some, face some
science: Same-tick-inclusive occupancy kernel on the y-probes: including the same-tick partner makes n(A_y)=(0,-1/3,0) nonzero where the strictly-earlier rule gave n(A_y)=0, and n(B)=(-1/3,-1/3,-1/3) with k=3. Both letters legal at all four probes -> reverse some (1/4), face some (1/4). Directly flips reverse from UNDEFINED (#7072) to `some` on the simultaneity convention alone, with `mutation-exclude-same-tick-changes-n` as the check.
